briefdescription.para: Generic CoefficientRing adapter that wraps an arbitrary const Ring* and forwards every operation to it.

detaileddescription.para: The catch-all implementation used wherever code expects the CoefficientRing operation surface but talks to a ring without a faster specialisation. All add / mult / subtract / invert calls delegate to the corresponding Ring virtual methods on R, and Element / ElementArray (defined nested here) supply the value-semantics wrappers the templated linear algebra code expects.
